scripts.text:
[Soy]
Mimi, what should I do?
My heart is beating so fast. Ahhh~
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
米米，我该怎么办？
我的心跳得好快。啊呜~

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Why is you face so flushed? Ha ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
你的脸怎么这么红？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Soy]
Don't make fun of me Mimi~
I have dreamed of being at Dancer Kim's stage for a very long time!
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
别取笑我啦，米米~
我梦想着能登上舞娘 金的舞台已经很久了！

scripts.text:
[Soy]
I might lose my senses if I really see her dancing like a beautiful angel sent from above.
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
如果真看到她像天使一样从天而降翩翩起舞，我可能会失去理智。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Calm down, Soy.
You are going to faint even before the performance starts. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
冷静点，索伊。
你还没开始表演就要晕倒了。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
But I understand you.
Many people are looking forward to meeting the best Wanderer in the world.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
但我理解你。
很多人都很期待见到世界上最棒的浪姬舞者。

scripts.text: Dancer Kim?
scripts.translation: 舞娘 金？

scripts.text: Wanderer?
scripts.translation: 浪姬舞者？

scripts.text:
[Soy]
What? You don't know the famous Wanderer, Dancer Kim?
Oh my, oh my!!!
You seem to know the art of dancing but how come you don't know her?
Oh, no!
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
什么？你不知道著名的浪姬舞者，舞娘 金？
天哪，天哪！！！
你似乎很懂舞蹈，怎么会不知道她呢？
哎呀，不行！

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
A Wanderer is a free-spirited person who wanders about the world with the wind and the stars.
Rhythm and Music accompany them wherever they go.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
浪姬舞者是与风和星辰一起漫游世界的自由灵魂。
节奏和音乐伴随他们左右。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Dancer Kim is the most famous Wanderer who tours the world with the Maestro Guitar Dong as the team <Nollio>.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
舞娘 金是最著名的浪姬舞者，她与吉他手 东组成的乐队<诺利奥>正在环游世界。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Soy and myself are Aspiring Wanderers, and there will be a performance of <Nollio> in this town soon, so we are eagerly looking forward to see it.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
我和索伊都是见习浪姬舞者，<诺利奥>很快就要在这个城镇演出了，我们非常期待。

scripts.text:
[Soy]
If you are a true Dancer, you must be struck with her Dance!
Will I ever meet a Maestro like Guitar Song someday, Mimi?
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
如果你是个真正的舞者，一定会被她的舞蹈所震撼！
米米，我将来能遇到像吉他之歌那样的大师吗？

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Just hang in there, Soy. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
加油吧，索伊。哈哈。

scripts.text: Where is the performance?
scripts.translation: 演出在哪里？

scripts.text: End the conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Soy]
Right in front of the Christmas tree!
White snow, beautiful melody, and my captivating dance.
Don't you think it would be a great performance?
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
就在圣诞树前！
白雪皑皑，旋律优美，还有我迷人的舞蹈。
你觉得这会是一场很棒的演出吗？

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
If you are interested in becoming a Wanderer, just come back to me anytime. Although I'm not perfect, I will try my best to help you.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
如果你想成为浪姬舞者，随时都可以来找我。虽然我不完美，但我会尽力帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Soy]
The performance will be held in front of the Christmas tree here in Lutie.
I can't wait! Ah~ I'm losing my senses, Mimi.
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
演出将在姜饼城的圣诞树前举行。
我等不及了！啊~我要失去理智了，米米。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
A Wanderer's dancing charm is higher than that of a dancer or gypsy, everyone will lose their souls when they see their performance.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
浪姬舞者的舞蹈魅力比舞娘或冷艳舞姬更高，看到她们表演的人都会为之着迷。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
I want to become a Wanderer, but I'm still a dancer.
But I think^3131FF it's better to learn Gypsy's unique skills first, and then become a Wanderer^000000. Soy can't wait to become a Wanderer.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
我想成为浪姬舞者，但我现在还是舞娘。
不过我觉得^3131FF最好先学会冷艳舞姬的专属技能，然后再转职为浪姬舞者^000000。索伊迫不及待想成为浪姬舞者的样子。

scripts.text:
[Soy]
<Nollio> is the best!!
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
<诺利奥>是最棒的！！

scripts.text:
[Soy]
I want to become an famous Wanderer too, Mimi.
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
米米，我也想成为著名的浪姬舞者。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Not sure if I'm greedy, but I need to learn all Dancer and Gypsy skills before I can become a Wanderer.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
不知道我是不是太贪心了，但在成为浪姬舞者之前，我需要学会所有舞娘和冷艳舞姬的技能。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Oh, what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
哎呀，我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Oh, what should I do?
Why did they do this?
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
哎呀，我该怎么办？
他们为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I am not sure if Guitar Song is in Comodo, you should go there and find him!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
我不确定吉他之歌是否在克魔岛，你应该去那里找他！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
They came back!!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
他们回来了！！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Thanks to you, the performance was successful.
You are so competent!
In return, I will prepare the stage for you someday.
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
多亏了你，演出很成功。
你真是能干！
作为回报，总有一天我会为你准备舞台的。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Ahhh, so distracting!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
啊，太让人分心了！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Hey, you there!
Please listen to my story.
Actually, I shouldn't tell anyone.
But I'm so overwhelmed that I might go crazy. Ahhhh~~!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
嘿，你在那里！
请听听我的故事。
其实我不该告诉任何人的。
但我太焦虑了，快要疯了。啊~~~~！

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't care.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不关心

scripts.text: What's the matter?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text: Why are you telling me this?
scripts.translation: 你为什么告诉我这些？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
That's a bit harsh don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
这有点太严厉了吧，你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
The performance is supposed to be soon!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
演出马上就要开始了！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Those people don't feel any responsibility..
We're all expecting them and I've promoted them a lot.
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
那些人完全没有责任感...
大家都在期待他们，我也大力宣传了。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I told you that I'm overwhelmed!
You don't understand me!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
我告诉过你我很焦虑！
你不懂我！

scripts.text: Is there a problem?
scripts.translation: 出什么问题了吗？

scripts.text: Who do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你指的是谁？

scripts.text: It has nothing to do with me.
scripts.translation: 这与我无关

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
How could they do that?
People will throw snowballs!
Maybe they will even throw a big snowman, no!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
他们怎么能这样？
人们会扔雪球的！
说不定还会扔大雪人过来，不！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
People might grab me by the collar!!
Swing swing, dangling dangling!!
This is awful.
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
人们可能会揪住我的衣领！！
甩来甩去，晃来晃去！！
太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Who?!
It's <Nollio>!
You call that a question?
They are the worst people in the world.
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
谁？！
是<诺利奥>！
你这是在问话吗？
他们是世界上最糟糕的人。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
What a heartless thing to say!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
真是没心没肺的话！

scripts.text: Are you afraid of people?
scripts.translation: 你怕人吗？

scripts.text: The performers caused trouble?
scripts.translation: 是表演者惹麻烦了吗？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Wouldn't you be afraid of all the eyes of people if you were me?
I am in charge of this performance! A lot of people are looking forward to see it and there are many sponsors who are supporting us! I'm so stressed.
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
换作是你，面对那么多人的目光难道不害怕吗？
我是这场演出的负责人！很多人都在期待这场演出，还有那么多赞助商在支持我们！我压力好大。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Yes!
<Nollio> has cancelled their performance!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
是的！
<诺利奥>取消了他们的演出！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
And they didn't give me any reason whatsoever!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
而且他们连个理由都没给我！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Besides the money I spent for promoting and setting up the stage..
How can I handle all the angry people?
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
除了我花在宣传和搭建舞台上的钱...
我该怎么应付那些愤怒的人？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Hey, where are you going!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
嘿，你要去哪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see that you are worried that the performance is going down the drain.
You wanted to make a successful performance to meet the fan's expectations.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我看出来你很担心演出会搞砸。
你想让演出成功，以符合粉丝的期待。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I really don't know how I should manage this.
Why did they suddenly cancel the performance?
Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
我真的不知道该怎么处理这件事。
他们为什么突然取消演出？
你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Why is <Nollio> taking this kind of attitude towards me?
Did I make any mistakes? After making a contract with them, I did everything they demanded of me!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
为什么<诺利奥>对我采取这种态度？
我有什么错吗？和他们签约后，我满足了他们所有的要求！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's because...

[Performance Manager]
What the hell are you talking about?
Are you teasing me because I'm emotionally unstable?
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
你在说什么鬼话？
因为我不稳定就在嘲笑我吗？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Oh, I'm so worried that I'm having heart palpitations and I'm starting to feel dizzy!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
哦，我担心得心跳加速，开始头晕了！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Hey! Can you please go out and find the Maestro Guitar Song?
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
嘿！你能不能出去找找吉他之歌大师？

scripts.text: Ah, okay.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了

scripts.text: Why should I do that?
scripts.translation: 我为什么要这么做？

scripts.text: I won't!
scripts.translation: 我不去！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
You're asking me why!?
Ahh, no.....
It's because you seem like a similar artist.
You also wanted to watch the performance, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
你问我为什么？！
啊，不……
是因为你看起来也是同行。
你也想去看演出，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
You are so cold-hearted....
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
你真是冷血无情……

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I would grab them by their collars if I could!
I would tell them Why are you spoiling the performance? but for now, dealing with the angry sponsors is hard enough... Oh, no!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
要是能抓住他们的衣领就好了！
我要问问他们为什么要破坏演出？不过现在，光是应付那些愤怒的赞助商就已经够难了……啊，不！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I don't know where Guitar Song is, but it is clear that he likes to visit the Comodo Casino!
Hu, Hurry up!! Oh, I really feel dizzy! Guitar Song!!!
scripts.translation:
[演出经理]
我不知道吉他之歌在哪里，但他肯定喜欢去克魔岛赌场！
呼，快一点！！我真的很头晕！吉他之歌！！！

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
You can dance ~
You can do your work ~
You are the dancing Queen ~
I am the tambourine King ~
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
你可以跳舞~
你可以工作~
你是舞动的皇后~
我是铃鼓之王~

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
呼……

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
You can dance ~
You can do your work ~
You are the dancing Queen ~
I am the tambourine King ~
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
你可以跳舞~
你可以工作~
你是舞动的皇后~
我是铃鼓之王~

scripts.text:
- You found a Maestro -
- singing a weird song. -
scripts.translation:
- 你发现了一位乐师 -
- 正在唱一首奇怪的歌曲。 -

scripts.text: That's a weird song.
scripts.translation: 那是一首奇怪的歌曲。

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text: - What a weird person, I better stay away. -
scripts.translation: - 真是个怪人，我还是离他远点好。 -

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
What?!
Are you ignoring my immortal masterpiece <Tambourine King>? You are the first person who's ever slapped me in the face.
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
什么？！
你无视我这首不朽的杰作《铃鼓之王》？你是第一个扇我耳光的人。

scripts.text: I didn't slap you.
scripts.translation: 我没有扇你耳光。

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
Oh! Lady, looking at your appearance you must be a dancer, right?
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
哦！女士，看你的外表，你一定是个舞娘，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
Do you have a Bard or Minstrel traveling together with you?
If you don't, how about making a traveling troupe with me?
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
你有诗人或宫廷乐师和你一起旅行吗？
如果没有，要不要和我一起组建一个旅行剧团？

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
The name of the team is <Guitar Song's Agony>.
This name expresses the excruciating pain it takes to create art works.
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
团名叫《吉他之歌的煎熬》。
这个名字表达了创作艺术作品所经历的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
It has an edgy kind of name So I think that it will be a very popular group.
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
这个名字很有个性，我觉得它会非常受欢迎。

scripts.text: Are you Guitar Song?
scripts.translation: 你是吉他之歌吗？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Huh... I'm a bit disappointed that you finally recognize me now.
Yes, I am the handsome Guitar Song in the famous group <Nollio>.
Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
哈……你终于认出我了，我有点失望。
是的，我就是著名团体《诺利奥》中帅气的吉他之歌。
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
So how about it? Isn't that a tempting offer to you?
I'm a really famous Maestro at the peak of my popularity. People are dying to work with me, but you are indifferent to me lady.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
那么，怎么样？这难道不是一个诱人的提议吗？
我是处于人气巅峰的著名乐师，人们都渴望与我合作，但你对我不屑一顾，女士。

scripts.text: Where is Dancer Kim?
scripts.translation: 舞娘金在哪里？

scripts.text: Why'd you cancel the performance?
scripts.translation: 为什么取消演出？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Why are you asking me that question so suddenly?
Come on, let's just talk about a pleasant matter.
Dancer Kim and the performance have nothing to do with me.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
你突然问这个干什么？
好了，我们聊点开心的事吧。
舞娘金和演出跟我没有任何关系。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Hey, I told you to stop talking about this matter....
I don't want to think about it. It just hurts my feelings.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
嘿，我说过别提这件事了……
我不想回想。这让我心里很不好受。

scripts.text: - Guitar Song is adamantly refusing to talk. What should I do to hear the story about <Nollio>? -
scripts.translation: - 吉他之歌坚决拒绝谈论此事。我该怎么做才能听到关于<Nollio>的故事？ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Would it be possible for me to make him tell me what happened with Nollio?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（有没有办法让他告诉我关于Nollio发生了什么？）

scripts.text: Use Dazzler
scripts.translation: 使用惊声尖叫

scripts.text: Use Lullaby
scripts.translation: 使用摇篮曲

scripts.text: Use Lucky Luck
scripts.translation: 使用幸运

scripts.text: - You get closer to Song's ear. -
scripts.translation: - 你凑近吉他之歌的耳边。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay-

[Guitar Song]
Wh...what!! What are you doing?!?
You almost damaged my eardrum.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
什...什么！！你在干什么？！
你差点把我的耳膜震破了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, cheer up!!!

[Guitar Song]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You should know, people are addicted to your music?
So many people are supporting you with anticipation.
Would you break your promise and let people down? Not giving people any reason?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你应该知道，人们都沉迷于你的音乐。
这么多人都满怀期待地支持着你。
你会违背承诺让大家失望吗？不给人们一个理由？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay-

[{0}]
Aaaaahhh!!!!!

[Guitar Song]
What... what are you doing?!! What's wrong with you!
Security!!!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
你...你在干什么？！你疯了吗！
保安！！

scripts.text:
[Black-suit Guards]
Please stop this.
scripts.translation:
[黑衣护卫]
请停止这种行为。

scripts.text: - You cannot use this skill without learning it. -
scripts.translation: - 在未学习该技能的情况下无法使用。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like I will not get answer even if I force him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来即使强迫他，我也得不到答案。

scripts.text: - You cannot use this skill without learning it. -
scripts.translation: - 在未学习该技能的情况下无法使用。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, ah my Guitar Song~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，啊，我的吉他之歌~

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
What? I've got goose bumps.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
什么？我起鸡皮疙瘩了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've been watching <Nollio> for years.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我关注<诺利奥>已经好几年了。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
I know that we are that popular! Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我知道我们很受欢迎！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've seen other Maestro's performances but there was no one better than Guitar Song.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我看过其他指挥家的表演，但没有谁比得上吉他之歌。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
He he he! Yes, I know I am super great!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
嘿嘿嘿！是的，我知道我超级棒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... When I hear Guitar Song's performance for the first time I has a crush on you immediately.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...当我第一次听到吉他之歌的表演时，我立刻对你一见钟情了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It felt like hearing mommy's lullaby~ It was so beautiful and moving... You are the best artist of our time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那感觉就像听到妈妈的摇篮曲~ 太美太动人了...你是我们这个时代最伟大的艺术家。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Ha ha ha. I know that well, but it feels good to hear a compliment from you!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
哈哈哈。我知道，但听到你的赞美感觉真好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So I was looking forward to seeing your performance in Lutie this time.
But after I heard the performance got cancelled, I felt so sad.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以我一直期待这次在姜饼城看到你的表演。
但听说表演取消了，我感到非常难过。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now I can't hear Guitar Song's melody~~
I wanted to dance to your music like a beautiful butterfly.
Is there no way for my dream to be true now? Sob sob...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在我听不到吉他之歌的旋律了~~
我想像美丽的蝴蝶一样随着你的音乐起舞。
我的梦想现在没有实现的可能了吗？呜呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Huh huh! No, that is not...
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
呼呼！不，不是这样的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am really happy to meet you in person, but I hope to see your performance in the beautiful snowy town, Lutie.. Sob sob...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很高兴能亲自见到你，但我希望能在美丽的雪城姜饼城看到你的表演。呜呜呜...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why in the world don't you show us the performance, Guitar Song?
Don't you like me? Sob sob..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
吉他之歌，你为什么不给我们表演呢？
你不喜欢我吗？呜呜呜..

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
No, it's not that kind of reason!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
不，不是那种原因！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then please tell me, I really love your music... but now I feel so blue...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那请告诉我，我真的喜欢你的音乐...但现在我感到很沮丧...

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Oh, no! You know...
I want to have a performance, too!
But I cannot do it all by myself!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
哦，不！你知道吗...
我也想举办一场表演！
但我一个人做不到！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
It's all because of Dancer Kim!
One day, she suddenly got mad and told me that she would quit <Nollio>!
I was also tired of here unpredictable feelings, too!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
这都是舞娘 金的错！
有一天，她突然发火，说要退出<诺利奥>！
我也受够了她变幻莫测的情绪！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Pshaw.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
哼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why did she get mad so suddenly?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她为什么突然发火？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
I don't know! She must be holding a grudge for something.
That's what she's like.
She suddenly disappeared and sent me a letter telling me that the team would be disbanded.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我不知道！她一定是因为什么事在记恨我。
她就是这样的人。
她突然消失了，还给我寄了一封信，说乐队要解散了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is Dancer Kim now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
舞娘 金现在在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Well, the letter was sent from Hugel.
I guess she might be back at her hometown.
That's where I met her for the first time.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
嗯，那封信是从毁葛寄来的。
我想她可能回到了家乡。
那是我第一次遇见她的地方。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Although she loses her temper easily, her dance is so wonderful....
I don't know what I am doing wrong.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
虽然她很容易发脾气，但她的舞蹈真的很美妙....
我不知道自己做错了什么。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
She smiled so happily that she likes the new song so much..
Who can dance to my music so wonderfully as she did?
Now my music and my life is history... (muttering).
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
她笑得很开心，说她非常喜欢这首新歌..
谁能像她那样，在我的音乐中跳出如此美妙的舞姿呢？
现在我的音乐和我的人生都成了过去...（喃喃自语）。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Dancer Kim is probably addicted to the monster races in Hugel again!
Back in the day when she was addicted to the monster races, who do you think got her out of it?
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
舞娘 金肯定又沉迷于毁葛的魔物赛跑了吧！
当年她沉迷魔物赛跑的时候，是谁把她拉出来的，你知道吗？

scripts.text: - You tell him what happened in Hugel and ask him to go back to Lutie. -
scripts.translation: - 告诉他姜饼城发生的事，让他回去找她。 -

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Oh oh~
You are silly Dancer Kim~
Without me, who else can take care of such a lady like you~
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
噢噢~
你这个傻乎乎的舞娘 金~
没有我，还有谁能照顾你这样的女士呢~

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
I'll go there right away and scold her.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我这就过去好好教训她一顿。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Okay, I will go to the Christmas tree in Lutie where the performance is supposed to be held.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
好的，我会去姜饼城的圣诞树那里，那里应该是举办表演的地方。

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
Where is my partner...
scripts.translation:
[郁郁寡欢的乐师]
我的搭档在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
(blank...)
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
（沉默...）

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Sob... sob...
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
呜...呜...

scripts.text: Why are you crying?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在哭？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
I gave up my dream...
*Sob *Sob.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
我放弃了我的梦想...
*呜 *呜。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
I said goodbye to my partner who had been working with me for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
我和那个与我合作了很久的搭档说了再见。

scripts.text: Why did you say goodbye?
scripts.translation: 你们为什么分开了？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
it's because... sob... sob!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
是因为...呜...呜！

scripts.text: You can tell me everything.
scripts.translation: 你可以告诉我一切。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
When Wanderers and Maestro's get together, their abilities become stronger.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
当浪姬舞者和乐师在一起时，他们的能力会变得更强。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
So when they travel, they often get together and perform duets.
They have a good time dancing and playing music.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
所以她们在旅行时，经常会聚在一起进行二重奏。
她们一边跳舞一边演奏音乐，度过了一段美好的时光。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
A few days ago, with my partner Guitar Song. I showed a beautiful dance to his music to many people as we usually do.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
几天前，我和我的搭档吉他之歌，像往常一样，伴着他的音乐向许多人展示了一段优美的舞蹈。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
I was really proud of being a Wanderer after I drew all of that enthusiastic applause.
Guitar Song also praised me.
I was so happy that day.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
在那片热烈的掌声中，我为自己是一名浪姬舞者而感到无比自豪。
吉他之歌也称赞了我。
那天我真的很开心。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
But...
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
但是...

scripts.text: What happened next?
scripts.translation: 后来发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
The following morning, I woke up and washed my fave and was looking for something to eat in my room..
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
第二天早上，我醒来洗了脸，正在房间里找吃的...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Then Guitar Song suddenly opened the door of my room for some reason and said ^3131FFHey! What the hell are.. you doing here?^000000 and then he threw me out of my room!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
然后吉他之歌不知为何突然推开了我房间的门，说^3131FF嘿！你他妈在...在这里干什么？^000000接着就把我赶出了房间！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
We've been together for a long time but how can he do such a thing to me?
At first, I thought he was kidding around with me! But when he kicked me out of my room...
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
我们在一起这么久了，他怎么能这样对我？
起初，我以为他只是在跟我开玩笑！但当他把我踢出房间时...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Why didn't he recognize my face?
Do you think he doesn't want to see my face without makeup?
Boo hoo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
他为什么认不出我的脸？
你觉得他是不想看到我没化妆的脸吗？
呜呜呜！

scripts.text: So you disbanded the team?
scripts.translation: 所以你们解散了队伍？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Are you also ignoring my wounded self-respect as a woman?
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
你也在无视我作为女性受伤的自尊心吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No! He is really a caring man!
But I don't think you disbanded your precious team just because of that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！他真的是个体贴的男人！
但我觉得你们解散珍贵的队伍，肯定不仅仅是因为这个原因。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
You're right.
It's not just because of that.
The real reason why I disbanded the team is...
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
你说得对。
不仅仅是因为这个。
我解散队伍的真正原因是...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
After that day, I went to my hometown, Hugel and I just stayed indoors.
It was then when Shide comforted me with sweet cakes.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
那天之后，我回到了家乡毁葛，一直待在家里。
那时是希德用美味的蛋糕安慰了我。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Shide's cake is so wonderful!
It is the most famous cake in Hugel with soft sponge cake and fresh fruits and sweet chocolate cream!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
希德的蛋糕太棒了！
那是毁葛最有名的蛋糕，有着松软的海绵蛋糕、新鲜的水果和香甜的巧克力奶油！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
It felt like all the angels of happiness came to comfort me when I tasted that sweet cake.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
当我品尝那块甜美的蛋糕时，感觉所有幸福的天使都来安慰我了。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
So I ate it every morning and every night.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
所以我每天早上和晚上都吃它。

scripts.text: Oh, you wouldn't...
scripts.translation: 噢，你不会...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
The angel of happiness took back my sadness and gave me a lot of belly fat!
Boo hoo hoo hoo!!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
幸福的天使带走了我的悲伤，却给了我很多腹部脂肪！
呜呜呜呜！！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Now I can't wear my dancing clothes!
I am not a dancer who dances like a beautiful butterfly anymore!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
现在我连舞蹈服都穿不下了！
我不再是那个像美丽蝴蝶一样起舞的舞娘了！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
What is worse, it became hard to bend my waist forward!
Boo hoo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
更糟糕的是，我的腰变得很难向前弯曲了！
呜呜呜呜！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
The performance day is approaching, but the angel of happiness brought me a big obstacle.
Now I've fallen into despair again!
I can't let Guitar Song and my fans see me like this!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
演出日就要到了，但幸福的天使却给我带来了巨大的障碍。
我又陷入了绝望之中！
我不能让吉他之歌和我的粉丝看到我这副样子！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
<Nollio> is over! Boo hoo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
<诺利奥>结束了！呜呜呜呜！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Not long ago, I was like a beautiful dove, but now I am just a fat chicken.
Sob sob...!
I think the life of Wanderer Dancer Kim is over now.
Boo hoo hoo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
不久前，我还像一只美丽的鸽子，现在却变成了一只肥鸡。
呜呜...！
我觉得浪姬舞者 金的人生已经结束了。
呜呜呜呜！

scripts.text: Hey, don't give up.
scripts.translation: 嘿，别放弃

scripts.text: I feel sorry for you.
scripts.translation: 我很同情你

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
My life cannot get out of abyss now......
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我现在的人生无法走出深渊了......

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
But I already told Guitar Song that it's all over.
Even if it's not over, I cannot do anything right now.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
但我已经告诉吉他之歌一切都结束了。
即使还没结束，我现在也什么都做不了了。

scripts.text: If you give up, it will be over.
scripts.translation: 如果你放弃，那就真的结束了

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
But in this situation...
Do I really have a way to change it?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
但在这种情况下...
我真的有办法改变现状吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Exercise is the best way!
If you work hard, your bossy will be lighter than before!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
运动是最好的方法！
如果你努力锻炼，你的腰围会比以前更细！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
But I get tired and give up easily.
I think I am going to give up.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
但我很容易累，也很容易放弃。
我想我还是会放弃的。

scripts.text: Well, there's no other way.
scripts.translation: 好吧，别无他法

scripts.text: Let's work together.
scripts.translation: 我们一起锻炼吧

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
No dreams and no hope...
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
没有梦想，也没有希望...

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Will you exercise together with me?
Really?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
你愿意和我一起锻炼吗？
真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I'm sure that I would try harder if I had someone to workout with.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
如果有人在旁边一起锻炼，我相信我会更努力的。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I feel better now!
I think I'm gaining strength again!
Let's work together!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我现在感觉好多了！
我觉得我又重新获得了力量！
我们一起努力吧！

scripts.text: What should we do first?
scripts.translation: 我们首先该做什么？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I have a good idea!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我有个好主意！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Meet me at Abyss Lake.
I'll see you there.
Just go one field South and one field West from here in Hugel.
I'll meet you there.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
在深渊湖见。
我会在那等你。
从毁葛这里往南走一格，再往西走一格。
我们在那里碰面。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I'll meet you at Abyss Lake.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我在深渊湖等你。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Please tell Guitar Song to go to Lutie
I'll go there after I've packed my luggage!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
请告诉吉他之歌去姜饼城。
等我收拾好行李就过去！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Where is my partner......
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
我的搭档在哪里......

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Exercising together is good but if we compete for it, I think we'll get a better effect!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
一起锻炼固然好，但如果我们比赛的话，我觉得效果会更好！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
From now on, let's compete to see who defeats the Yellow Novus first!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
从现在开始，我们来比赛谁先击败黄诺博斯吧！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
You need to defeat 50 Yellow Novus!
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
你需要击败50只黄诺博斯！
准备好了吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Hurry up before I lose interest!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
快点啦，别让我失去兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Good! Then ready, set~~
Go!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
好！那么预备~~
开始！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Whew!
Looks like I've lost!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
呼！
看来我输了！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
This feeling reminds me of the past where I've crossed the borders of many continents.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
这种感觉让我想起了过去，我曾跨越许多大陆的边界。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Ah! Look at this!
I'm getting slimmer, can you see it?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
啊！你看这个！
我变苗条了，你看到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I feel that my body is full of power.
I suddenly want to see my good partner Guitar Song.
I want to start dancing again.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我感觉身体充满了力量。
我突然很想见见我的好搭档吉他之歌。
我想重新开始跳舞了。

scripts.text: How about dancing in Lutie?
scripts.translation: 去姜饼城跳舞怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Ah! Christmas Village! Yes! Yes!
My dream to dance in Lutie will finally come true.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
啊！圣诞村庄！是的！是的！
我在姜饼城跳舞的梦想终于要实现了。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I want to dance and jump all day to bring people happiness!
So I will go to Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我想整天跳舞跳跃，给人们带来快乐！
所以我要去姜饼城。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Ah, do me a favor, please.
Can you bring Guitar Song to Lutie?
Say that his partner is waiting for him.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
啊，请帮我个忙。
你能带吉他之歌去姜饼城吗？
告诉他他的搭档在等他。

scripts.text: No problem!
scripts.translation: 没问题！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
You're a good person. I'm really happy that I met you.
Thank god for sending such a stubborn person to me!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
你真是个好心人。我很高兴能遇到你。
感谢上天派了这样一个固执的人给我！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Does it look easy to you?
But I'm sure I have a better chance to win.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
这看起来很容易吗？
但我确信我赢面更大。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Oh, you came back to me.
I'm so tired. I don't give up halfway. It's a good exercise for me. I will have to give up Nollio to another Wanderer, it's all over....
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
你回来了。
我好累。我不会半途而废，这对我来说是很好的锻炼。不过，我不得不把<诺利奥>交给另一位浪姬舞者了，一切都结束了...

scripts.text: - Dancer Kim dropped down by grief and fatigue -
scripts.translation: - 舞娘 金因悲伤和疲惫倒下了 -

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Huh...?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
嗯...？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Please tell Song, I will be waiting for him at the Christmas tree.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
请告诉吉他之歌，我会在圣诞树旁等他。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Hunting Novus is the best exercise, I think.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我觉得打黄诺博斯是最好的锻炼。

scripts.text: - You can't continue the quest because the condition for the quest is not appropriate. -

scripts.text: - You can't continue the quest because you have remaining skill points. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您还有剩余的技能点，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: - You need to empty your inventory if you want to continue the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 如果您想继续任务，需要清空您的物品栏。 -

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Please get off of that creature you're riding on.
Then talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
请从您骑乘的生物上下来。
然后再来和我说话。

scripts.text: - <Nollio> is performing. -
scripts.translation: - <诺利奥>正在表演。 -

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
One! Two! Three!
Blue fish dancing~
Fan! Fan! Fan! I am your fan~
With a strong mind and strong will, I complete fishing~
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
一！二！三！
蓝色鱼在跳舞~
风！风！风！我是你的粉丝~
凭借坚定的意志和决心，我完成了钓鱼~

scripts.text:
[Spectators]
AAAAhhhhhhhhh - - !!!
So cool! Nollio is the best!!!
scripts.translation:
[观众]
啊啊啊啊啊 - - ！！
太酷了！诺利奥是最棒的！！！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Hello, ladies and gentlemen!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
大家好，女士们先生们！

scripts.text:
[Spectators]
Hello!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[观众]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
We are the romantic Wanderer team <Nollio> who stroll along the world following love and wind!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我们是浪漫的浪姬舞者组合<诺利奥>，我们沿着世界漫步，追随爱与风！

scripts.text:
[Spectators]
Wowwwww~!
scripts.translation:
[观众]
哇哇哇~！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
It's so fascinating that I can dance in a snowy, beautiful village,
I'm so glad that I came here, Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
能在美丽雪景的村庄里跳舞，真是太迷人了，
我很高兴能来到姜饼城。

scripts.text:
[Spectators]
Yayyyy~
scripts.translation:
[观众]
耶耶耶~

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
In fact, this wonderfull performance would have been cancelled because of my carelessness.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
事实上，这场精彩的表演本来会因为我的疏忽而取消。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
I unintentionally made her upset.
Let me take this opportunity to say to her that I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我不小心让她生气了。
请让我借此机会向她道歉。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
It's okay.
I'm sorry for behaving as I did.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
没关系。
抱歉我刚才那样做。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
In fact there is a friend who cheered me up and helped me get through the hardships I faced when I was depressed in my hometown.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
其实有一位朋友在我家乡陷入低谷时，鼓励我并帮助我度过了难关。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
You may love my friend's dance more than mine in the future.
She has a great talent.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
未来你可能会更喜欢我朋友的舞蹈。
她非常有天赋。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Introducing!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
隆重介绍！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
This rising Wanderer star, {0}!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
这位冉冉升起的浪姬舞者新星，{0}！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Ha ha ha, are you surprised?
Don't look so puzzled?
You led me here, you deserve it.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
哈哈，你惊讶吗？
别一脸困惑的样子。
是你把我带到这里来的，这是你应得的。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Oh! You are like a beautiful swan!
The goddess must be jealous to see your beauty.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
哦！你就像一只美丽的天鹅！
女神看到你的美貌一定会嫉妒的。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
{0}! I hope to see your beautiful exploits in the future.
Also, I hope you to meet your precious Maestro.
Let's perform together later, shall we? Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
{0}！希望未来能看到你精彩的表演。
也希望你遇到你珍贵的指挥家。
以后我们一起表演吧，好吗？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Thanks to you, I didn't lose my precious partner.
Thank you a lot.
Soon I will make a song for you, so wait for it.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
多亏了你，我没有失去我珍贵的搭档。
非常感谢。
很快我会为你写一首歌，敬请期待。
